PostToolUse.description: Coder progress marker — append durable activity log for PM silent-termination recovery

PreToolUse.description: Safety gate — block catastrophic Bash patterns (rm -rf /, force push to main, DROP DATABASE crm_db)
Coder push gate — require ac_verified: in commit msg before push on feature|fix|infra|test branches
Prettier push gate — block git push when PR-changed files are not prettier-formatted (local mirror of CI check-formatting; worktree-safe, fail-loud)

Devserver TTL gate — block raw dev-server boots (nest/vite/pnpm dev/dist-main) inside agent worktrees and claude scratchpads without scripts/devops/dev-ttl.sh wrapper (zombie prevention, 2026-07-24 incident)

Live-DB guard — block dev-server boots (nest/vite/pnpm dev/dist-main) inside agent worktrees and claude scratchpads unless DATABASE_URL and port are explicitly set inline to non-live values (live-db-corruption prevention, 2026-08-05 incident PR #485)

Cross-agent blast gate — from an agent workspace, block broadcast process kills (pkill/killall), removing/pruning another agent's worktree, and mutating another agent's tree or the shared checkout (2026-08-17 incidents PR #547 / #544 / #551). Reads and kill-by-PID stay allowed.

Dispatch isolation gate — block dispatching a WRITING subagent (coder/autotest/devops/ui-ux-designer/manual-qa/legal/pm/architect) without isolation=worktree or an explicit cwd, and block handing a shared absolute work dir in the prompt. Read-only agents pass untouched (PR #497 / #493).
Zone-of-write gate — block apps/** and packages/** edits from non-Coder sessions
Compact suggestion — surface /compact reminder every 50 Edit/Write invocations (never blocks)
